# DreamCision AI·SCRIBE
# Clinical documentation workspace for healthcare providers

## Overview
DreamCision AI·SCRIBE is an internal clinical documentation tool that assists healthcare providers with generating clinical notes, managing patient encounters, and providing evidence-based medical Q&A.

## Features
- Clinical note generation (consultation, follow-up, SOAP, etc.)
- Patient encounter management
- Medical literature Q&A with evidence citations
- Audio transcription (ASR)
- Image/PDF upload for chart data
- RAG-powered medical knowledge retrieval

## API Endpoints
- `/api/generate_v8_stream` - Note generation (SSE)
- `/api/transcribe_diarized` - Audio transcription
- `/api/qa_chat` - Medical Q&A
- `/api/ocr` - Image/PDF text extraction

## Authentication
All API endpoints require authentication via session tokens.

## Privacy
This is an internal clinical tool. All patient data is protected under PHIA. No external API exposure.
